question: How do measured GLM-4.7-Flash L40S costs compare with current provider prices, and what traffic does the exact model receive on OpenRouter?

scope.local_workload: cache-off, thinking-disabled, 8192 input / 1024 output tokens per request, c16 unless noted

hypothesis_and_falsification.hypothesis: The measured exact-model deployment is commercially close even if it has not reached output-only retail parity, and OpenRouter carries material exact-model demand.
hypothesis_and_falsification.falsified_if: Normalized local cost is not competitive at reasonable utilization, or the exact OpenRouter permaslug has negligible seven-day traffic.

modified_quality_deferred_proxies.claim_limit: Both alter model depth and are architecture-cost evidence only; neither is currently quality eligible.

derived_market_proxy.method: Apply the lowest displayed OpenRouter list rates to public aggregate tokens, charging reported cached prompt tokens at the displayed cache-read rate; upper bound charges all prompt tokens at input rate.
derived_market_proxy.claim_limit: This is not OpenRouter revenue, provider revenue, or model-wide TAM; actual provider routing, discounts, free traffic, cache accounting, and reasoning billing can differ.

sources.title: Z.ai: GLM 4.7 Flash
sources.evidence_type: vendor-reported public model page and page payload

sources.title: OpenRouter model activity JSON used by the public model page

limitations: The local 552.171 tok/s figure is aggregate c16 throughput, whereas Artificial Analysis reports one-request-at-a-time post-first-token speed; speed values are not directly comparable.

The local workload uses an 8:1 input/output ratio with cache disabled; Artificial Analysis's headline blend uses 7 cache-hit input : 2 uncached input : 1 output. Blended prices are therefore not matched claims.
Local figures are accelerator COGS at a planning rate, not fully loaded delivered cost or retail price, and exclude orchestration, storage, failures, headroom, margin, and quality risk.
OpenRouter traffic is one distribution channel and includes reasoning/cached-token accounting exposed by that platform; it is not total global model usage.
The current selective-W4 full47 experiment has no scientific result yet and is excluded.
next_action: Measure the corrected full47 selective-W4 c16/c32 endpoint, then run an Artificial Analysis methodology-matched service test and recompute fully loaded cost at observed utilization.
